text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Just a bit more!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Yeah... I've got this! I'm gonna win! Just
keep
going! Just... keep...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ah! ...Damn it! Damn it all straight to
hell!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Dammit... I just can't do it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(I know what's causin' this. I just can't
close that
three-centimeter gap.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Nothing's changed. I'm still fated to
lose. My
future hasn't budged at all...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not true. The number changed
from
seven to three, and even that
should've been
impossible.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I have to do this. 'Cause if I don't...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Eep!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I spin around, startled by a loud crashing
noise
behind me, and spot none other
than Meisho
Doto sprawled on the floor.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm fine... I've landed on my bottom so
many
times today, it's flat as a board.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh, but more importantly...
choice_data_list: （それは大丈夫ではないのでは？）

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um, I wanted to talk with you about
Shakur...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Well, I think, um... she's been having a
lot of
nightmares.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I've noticed her bolting awake in the
middle of
the night. It's gotten a lot
worse lately...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I was hoping that... that you could help
her out!
Please!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
She'll probably get mad at me for telling
you this,
but...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Even though she's done so much for me,
I haven't
done anything for her, so...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
So I thought you might be able to help
since
you're her trainer.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Like I said, I'm not actually expecting
anything
from you.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: That goes for your ideas too. I expect practically nothing from you, but I'd still rather have almost nothing than nothing at all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, I don't feel like I can do
anything to
help Air Shakur, but I also
don't want to dash
Meisho Doto's hopes.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Thank goodness...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'll also make sure to stop falling out of
bed too
loudly so she can sleep in
peace!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Shakur's anxieties must be getting really bad if she's having nightmares...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
According to Parcae's predictions, I'm
not gonna
win a single race after the
Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't even imagine how terrifying it
must be to
head down a path of certain
failure, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even now, at this very moment...
choice_data_list: （シャカールは向かうことを選んだ）

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Tch. The results haven't changed at all.
Ugh, I'm
getting real fed up with this
stupid
991031021222 thing!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should swap out the whole
table... No,
that won't work. I'd already
tried that before.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'd even settle for askin' the spirits or
whatever
for help if that'd actually do
anything...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: No, no, no! It's wrong! It's all wrong! Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Dammit!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I've brought it down to three measly
centimeters.
I'm so close... There's gotta
be somethin' I can do
to make this work.
If not...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: If not...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Screw it. I'm redoing it from scratch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Is watching uselessly as she heads
toward the
flames really the only thing
I'm capable of?
choice_data_list: （私には何もできないのかな）
choice_data_list_en: (Is there really nothing I can do?)
(Is there really nothing I can do?)
